$comment: Source of truth for price groups and channels. Synced into the database on every start.
Change it with a pull request: the AI review and your approval protect these business rules.
costSource: PRODUCT = product master (brand + model/code) | PROJECT = cost per project id | LANDED = imported item, cost calculated from factory price
formula: MULTIPLY = special x (1-d1)(1-d2)(1-d3) | GP_ON_NORMAL = normal x (1-d1)(1-d2)(1-d3) - (normal - special)
indicatorRules: checked in order; 'below' = strictly less than, 'upTo' = less than or equal; anything above the last rule is OKAY
discount: label, default, min, max (fractions, 0.2 = 20%), editable. Non-editable discounts are always the default.
priceTier (PRODUCT channels): which SMG MASTER selling price the channel uses — GT (col H), DGT (col I, online) or BT (col R). Products without a hot price use the Nationwide promotion price.

gpTiers: GP tier of a customer group (Customer Price Mapping, Customer Groups column I). Each step takes the item's own rate from SMG MASTER (rate key = column: SCGH K, T15 L, T18 M, T20 N, T24 O, BT_GP T, BT_MKT U, BT_DC V, DST1 Y) and falls back to 'default' when the item has none; steps compound (PCT_RUNNING). replacesTerms: Group Terms the tier replaces. NONPC: the wholesale net price (cost file tab WHOLESALE, GP DISC. of the DisplayinUPC = TRUE row); items not in that list use the 'fallback' tier. fee: a step that is a fee, not a discount — 0% there is normal and is not flagged as 'no discount for this item'.
gpZeroRateFlag: warning shown when an item's own GP in SMG MASTER is 0% for the group's tier (fee steps excluded) — the owner's reading of a 0% cell. Empty = no warning.
gpRateMax: a GP % above this in SMG MASTER is treated as a typo: skipped (tier default used) and listed in the sync report.
gpZeroRateFlag: อาจยกเลิก ไม่มีสต็อก หรือไม่ขายในช่องทางนี้ ตรวจสอบก่อนเสนอราคา
